propositions: Plan-review grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing when they are created by prerequisite tickets because they only check the origin/main snapshot and ignore depends_on relationships

A machine-parseable inline citation grammar `<subject> [rebar:<ticket-id>]` must be introduced and honored via a two-layer protocol (deterministic advisory edge-check + LLM coverage verification) to credit relied-upon functionality without adding a blocking floor check

Layer 1 must parse `[rebar:<id>]` tokens and verify each cited id is a direct upstream prerequisite using both P.depends_on(C) and reverse lookup C.blocks(P), emitting advisory findings for unbacked citations without blocking

Layer 2 must trigger LLM show_ticket coverage judgment only when a grounding finder would flag a symbol missing AND that symbol is cited with a Layer-1-verified edge, crediting the citation only if the reviewer confirms the cited ticket provides that specific functionality
Error handling must be fail-closed: any exception during reverse-lookup or show_ticket retrieval is caught and treated as unverified (advisory finding stands, no exception propagates)
The behavioral-eval protocol must demonstrate that verified+covered citations suppress missing-symbol findings while edge-unbacked or coverage-absent citations do not receive wrongful credit
